items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: They'd always give us the job if Trent wasn't in town. See, Alphonso Trent was the best colored band down in this part of the country back in them days.

ctx.x: New Year's Eve and Halloween night. And them big football games. They had a big football game come here, with a big colored player, it would be college... They'd have the (?) at the game, and they hired the band. They'd always give us the job if Trent wasn't in town. See, Alphonso Trent was the best colored band down in this part of the country back in them days.
You say they were the best band. Does that mean they had the best instruments, the best uniforms and the best pay? Or does it mean that they also played the best solos and had the best soloists?
